about: Items not mapped in this milestone and why. Classifications come from the DATA-FOUNDATION catalog and engine-pending.json; no new product states.

not_engine_proven.pending_detail: Registry hard-codes 5 lugs (ignores the lug-count input). Live mixes measurement conventions (adjacent-stud geometry for 4/5/8 lugs, PCD = measurement for 6) and its fallback branch for other lug counts returns meas/(2 sin(π/n)), a RADIUS, labelled as bolt-circle DIAMETER (2x error). Needs a sourced convention decision.
Not all registry inputs are rendered with defaults; needs per-mode review.

Registry output "Motor Power (kW)" = 340.8 kW; live displays the same power as 457 HP. Per the canonical-units decision (native US/Imperial), the registry output should be HP; that is a formula change and needs re-verification.
Trap-speed vs ET mode; the ET input is not rendered in the default (trap) mode.
Registry: shift RPM = peak-HP RPM (3 inputs). Live: searches the torque curve for the shift point that maximises wheel torque (7 inputs). Also shows a shift RPM when peak-HP RPM is 0.

Live displays 0° (with a warning line) when the axle-to-pivot distance is 0, where the angle is undefined. Unknown/invalid must not display as zero. Engine returns atan(x/0)=90°, also invalid: needs a >0 domain rule in the registry.

D-009 can declare F/C/K, but the live renderer rounds a different chain of intermediates per source unit (e.g. from F: K is computed from C already rounded to 2 dp; from K: K is the input itself). No single registry expression over bound constants reproduces every option exactly; it would match only within tolerance. Owner scope lock: stays pending; live formula not altered.
Solve-for distance/time/speed modes; the distance input is hidden in the default mode.
